verdict.rationale: Adyen's own tipping docs describe tipping from the terminal and from the POS app. Shoppers can accept, change, or decline a suggested tip on the payment terminal, and Adyen can configure accounts to prompt for a tip on every standalone payment. However, the configurable prompt types the story names (percentage presets, smart amounts) are not documented in the evidence, and custom tips are only implied by the shopper's ability to change the suggested amount. Missing for 10: documented percentage-based tip presets, smart/threshold tip amounts, an explicit custom-tip entry option, merchant-ops self-service configuration of tip prompts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal

citations.quote: There are various ways to implement tipping ('gratuity'). These are your options: Tipping from the POS app... Tipping from the terminal... Tipping on the receipt
The customer then accepts, changes, or declines the suggested tip amount on the payment terminal and completes the payment.
We can configure your account to automatically [prompt for a tip with every standalone payment]
